duplicateReview: Items 02 and 06 match withdrawal descriptions in Deal Chronological file CF00697-005, but the Gates file supplies released annotated copies.
Items 04 and 07 have released parallel copies in Deal Chronological files CF00697-005 and CF00697-001; the Gates copies retain recipient-file annotations.
Item 03 has a transmitted parallel copy in CF00697-005; the sender-file transmittal may control.
Items 08a-08c are a three-version set. Item 08c, marked ORIGINAL 8/30, is the only version promoted to the chronology.

Items 10-10d and the two unlisted administrative pages form a parallel August 29 NSC packet in H-Files NAIDs 470760959 and 470760960; no duplicate chronology candidates were created from the Gates copy.
methodology: Selected-file audit only. The first PDF page controls provenance. Every served-PDF page was mapped to the opening inventory, later release sheets, listed documents, or unlisted released pages; document candidates were then deduplicated against the harvested Deal Chronological and H-Files NSC Meetings collections.
